description: Unpruned GLM-5.2 (744B total, 40B active; QuantTrio Int4-Int8Mix, compressed-tensors) on four Sparks with vLLM tensor parallel 4 over the native multi-node launcher, a 200,000-token context, FP8 DeepSeek-MLA KV in a fixed 10.95 GB pool, MTP with four drafted tokens, FLASHMLA_SPARSE attention with the Triton sparse-MLA kernels and b12x, and full CUDA graphs. Basis: tonyd2wild's recipe (Apache-2.0; kernels from CosmicRaisins/glm-5.2-gb10, mods from ciprianveg, decode-aware scheduler by penguinchang, all Apache-2.0) on drowzeys' published probe-modded vLLM ab666069 image, which carries the same tag name upstream builds locally; upstream's run-time kernel bind mounts are copied into the image at build time. Related recipes for this model and Spark count: glm-5-2-quanttrio-vllm-four (drowzeys kit) and the same creator's NVFP4-KV variant. Upstream figures (32.5 tok/s mean, 36 peak single stream) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical four-Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.91 beside the fixed 10.95 GB FP8 KV pool and a 200,000-token context, as in tonyd2wild's launch.sh at 162d7a76 (lines 208 and 209); with a fixed pool the utilization is vLLM's startup free-memory check, and upstream rejects 0.90 explicitly (README line 367). Upstream runs with 0.6 to 0.9 GB of MemAvailable and 3.6 to 4.5 GB of swap in steady state (README lines 342-345). The declared peak is the per-rank loading floor: the weights, the pool and 8 GB of runtime overhead; the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: GLM 5.2 QuantTrio 200K MTP vLLM four Sparks
